body.markdown_zh:
前几天，我和《宝可梦☆星期天》的戈尔戈所长对战了一场！

这场对战的实况将在１０月１４日（星期日）的[宝可梦☆星期天](http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/pokemon_sunday/)中播出！！

结果究竟如何！！！

而且，居然还有礼物！！

大家一定要记得收看哦！！

那么！




<details class="gf-director-language"><summary>查看官方英文版</summary>

The other day I did a battle with “Golgo”

the Center Chief of Pokemon Sunday!

(“Golgo the Center Chief” is one of the regular

personalities in Pokemon Sunday, a TV program.)

The scene will be broadcast in Pokemon Sunday on

October 14th (Sun).

How did it turn out???

The viewers have a chance to win presents too!!

Please check it out!!

(This episode was aired in 2007 and no longer

available.)

See ya!


</details>
body.markdown_ja:
先日、ポケモン☆サンデーのゴルゴ所長と戦ってきました！

その模様が、１０月１４日（日）の[ポケモン☆サンデー](http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/pokemon_sunday/)に放送されます！！

結果がどうなったか！！！

そして、何とプレゼントも！！

ぜひ、みなさん観て下さいね！！

では！
